title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-03-21

ai_review.summary: A lively audience‑cassette capture of a late‑60s/early‑70s show with solid sound, standout Not Fade Away (China Cat tease) and classic covers.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience tape that delivers surprisingly clear and lively sound for its era, preserving the energy of the crowd and a strong performance of Not Fade Away (complete with a fun China Cat tease). The setlist is praised for its mix of vintage Dead material and early rock ’n’ roll covers, though the file suffers from duplicate tracks and the tail end of Not Fade Away being cut off.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate 4–5 stars, highlighting both a good musical performance and an above‑average audience recording; only one mixed review lowers the average slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cassette‑tape audience capture is described as solid, clear for its time and “well recorded,” with lively crowd ambience. Issues noted: duplicate tracks (two Uncle John's Band, two Cosmic Charlie), missing songs in the file set, and the end of Not Fade Away being cut off.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers call the setlist “pretty good,” noting classic covers and a strong late‑show slot. The overall flow is praised despite some missing tracks in the archived files.
